posting.title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager
posting.rawText:
Senior Growth Marketing Manager
Lumen Retail · Mumbai, India · Hybrid (3 days a week in the office)

About Lumen Retail
Lumen Retail runs 140 home-lighting stores and a fast-growing online shop. We are building a growth team that treats every channel as an experiment.

What you will do
- Own acquisition and retention across paid, lifecycle and owned channels for the online shop.
- Run a disciplined experimentation programme: hypotheses, holdouts and readouts.
- Build the weekly performance view for the leadership team.
- Lead a team of marketers and agency partners.

What you need
- Must have 5+ years of growth, performance or lifecycle marketing experience at a consumer brand.
- Must have hands-on ownership of a paid media budget above ₹1 crore a year across Meta Ads and Google Ads.
- Required: strong command of lifecycle marketing on email and WhatsApp, using an ESP such as Klaviyo, CleverTap or MoEngage.
- Required: a proven A/B testing and experimentation practice.
- Required: experience leading a team of at least 5 people.
- Required: fluent in English and Hindi.
- Must have worked with a customer data platform such as Segment or mParticle.

Nice to have
- Experience building dashboards in Looker Studio or Power BI.
- Marketing mix modelling or multi-touch attribution.
- Shopify Plus experience.
- MBA or postgraduate degree in marketing.
- Familiarity with SQL.

Eligibility
- Must be authorised to work in India and able to be in the Mumbai office three days a week.
- Candidates must hold a bachelor's degree.

How to apply
Apply at https://careers.lumenretail.example/jobs/sgmm-2291 or read more at https://www.lumenretail.example/about.

facts.text: Geo holdout testing

refs.quote: Own the paid acquisition budget across Meta Ads and Google Ads (₹3.2 crore a year) and cut blended CAC from ₹610 to ₹455 after a geo holdout test.

We switched off Meta prospecting in four cities for three weeks and compared orders against matched cities. The holdout showed that 70% of the channel's last-click revenue would have happened anyway, and we moved the budget to search and lifecycle.

paragraphs.text: I am a Growth Marketing Manager at Brightwell Foods, and before that I was a Performance Marketing Specialist at Pinecrest Media. The Senior Growth Marketing Manager role at Lumen Retail asks for growth, performance and lifecycle marketing at a consumer brand, and that is the work I have done in both places. Both jobs were about turning spend and messaging into growth that someone could measure, and I like that kind of accountability.

At Brightwell Foods I led the lifecycle email and WhatsApp programme for 400,000 subscribers on CleverTap. Repeat purchase rate rose from 22% to 31% in two quarters. Your posting asks for strong lifecycle marketing on email and WhatsApp, and this programme is the clearest example I have of that work. It is also the programme I know best, from the first message plan to the results review.

I also own the paid acquisition budget across Meta Ads and Google Ads, which is ₹3.2 crore a year. After a geo holdout test I cut blended CAC from ₹610 to ₹455. That test is how I decide where paid spend goes, and it is the habit I would bring to Lumen Retail. Paid media is a place where it is easy to trust a dashboard and be wrong, so I prefer to hold a region back and compare.

On experimentation, I ran 38 A/B tests on landing pages and checkout nudges. Five winners shipped and added 6.4% to site conversion. I treat each test as a decision that has to be defended with numbers, and I would run the growth programme at Lumen Retail the same way. I would also share every readout with the wider team, whatever it showed.
I have not yet worked with a customer data platform such as Segment or mParticle.
Thank you for your time. I would welcome a conversation about the role.
